hypotheses.C1_fisher_individual_effects_cancel: For the Fisher set, the median Fisher energy of the signed sum of individual effects is at most 25% of the summed individual energies on both corpora.
hypotheses.C2_exact_joint_effect_remains_cancelled: For the Fisher set, the median exact joint-effect energy is at most 25% of the summed individual energies on both corpora.
hypotheses.C3_joint_nonlinearity_is_not_the_explana: The signed sum of individual effects predicts the exact joint effect with median Fisher fidelity at least 0.90 on both corpora and both routes.
hypotheses.C4_fisher_set_cancels_more_than_local_se: The Fisher set's exact joint cancellation ratio is at most half the local set's on both corpora.
hypotheses.C5_cancellation_is_ood_stable: The Fisher exact joint cancellation ratio changes by no more than 0.10 between FineWeb and WikiText.
